Happy Birthday

happy happy birthday to you my loveeee!

first of all, gusto ko lang sabihin na kung gaano ako ka thankful na dumating ka sa buhay ko. i'm soafer lucky to have someone like you, someone who makes my ordinary days feel special kaya sana maging masaya ang araw mo ngayon, filled with love, happiness, and countless blessings because you deserve nothing but the best.

thank you for being part of my life, sa lahat ng effort, care, and love na binibigay mo sa akin. i may not always find the right words to express how much you mean to me, pero sana alam mo kung gaano ka kahalaga sa akin. you are the one and only reason why i smile, and i'm genuinely happy that i get to be part of your life.

i wish you good health, more happiness, success, and courage to achieve all your dreams. sana lahat ng prayers mo ay unti-unting matupad, and whenever life gets difficult, i hope you never forget how strong and capable you are. always believe in yourself because i believe in you too, like always.

i hope mag enjoy ka sa special day mo ngayon mahal kooo. huwag mong kakalimutang alagaan ang sarili mo and always choose your happiness. i may not be able to give you everything you want, but i promise to appreciate you, support you, and make you feel loved in my own little ways.

happy birthday po ulit, love loveeee koooo!! more birthdays, memories, and more things for us to do together. i'm so so so grateful to have you in my lifeeeeee. mahal na mahal kitaaaa, always and in all waysss.
